# Future Foams

> > Western Australia's only foam manufacturer specializing in polyurethane, polystyrene, and memory foam products for cushioning, insulation, and packaging applications.

Future Foams is a Perth-based foam manufacturing company offering locally-made foam products including flexible foams, rigid insulation foams, and specialty materials. The company emphasizes local manufacturing, quality standards, and sustainable practices through recycling partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Polyurethane foam
- Memory Foam
- Evolution Foams
- Quantum Foams
- Polystyrene supplies
- Flexible foam grades
- Foam density and hardness
- Local manufacturing
- Foam insulation
- Dacron wadding
- Packaging solutions
- Perth, Western Australia
- Product warranties
- Foam recycling
- AS 2282 standards

## Foam Products & Grades

- [Flexible Foams Direct from the Manufacturer](https://www.futurefoams.com.au/foam-grades-and-applications): Flexible foam grades, applications, and comparison with Evolution and Standard foams
- [Evolution Foams](https://www.futurefoams.com.au/evolution-foams): Evolution Foams product specifications with ten-year warranty and density ratings
- [Quantum Foams](https://www.futurefoams.com.au/quantum-foams): Quantum Foams product line with Medium, Soft, and Firm cushioning options
- [Memory Foam](https://www.futurefoams.com.au/memory-foam): Memory Foam viscoelastic polyurethane product for seat toppers and bed overlays
- [Dacron/Wadding](https://www.futurefoams.com.au/dacron-wadding): Dacron wadding polyester wrapping for foam cushion protection and upholstery
